# CSS 背景属性完全指南（02）：代码示例

## 代码示例

### background-color 背景颜色

```css
/* 多种颜色格式 */
.element {
  /* 颜色名称 */
  background-color: red;
  
  /* 十六进制 */
  background-color: #ff0000;
  background-color: #f00; /* 简写 */
  background-color: #ff000080; /* 带透明度 */
  
  /* RGB/RGBA */
  background-color: rgb(255, 0, 0);
  background-color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5);
  background-color: rgb(255 0 0 / 50%); /* 现代语法 */
  
  /* HSL/HSLA */
  background-color: hsl(0, 100%, 50%);
  background-color: hsl(0deg 100% 50% / 50%); /* 现代语法 */
  
  /* 特殊值 */
  background-color: transparent; /* 透明 */
  background-color: currentColor; /* 继承文字颜色 */
}
```


#### background-color 交互演示（MDN）

设置元素背景颜色，支持颜色名称、十六进制、RGB、HSL 等全部颜色格式。

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>background-color 属性演示 - MDN 示例</title>
    <meta name="description" content="边框与背景示例：background（color 属性演示）。" />
    <style>
      * {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }
      body {
        font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
        min-height: 100vh;
        padding: 0;
      }
      .demo-layout {
        display: flex;
        height: 100vh;
        gap: 0;
      }
      .snippet-panel {
        width: 320px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        padding: 16px;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 8px;
        overflow-y: auto;
        border-right: 1px solid #ddd;
        background: #fafafa;
      }
      .snippet-btn {
        padding: 10px 14px;
        border: 1px solid #ccc;
        border-radius: 6px;
        background: #fff;
        font-family: "JetBrains Mono", "Fira Code", monospace;
        font-size: 13px;
        color: #333;
        cursor: pointer;
        text-align: left;
        transition: all 0.2s;
        line-height: 1.4;
      }
      .snippet-btn:hover {
        border-color: #8083ff;
        background: #f0f0ff;
      }
      .snippet-btn.active {
        border-color: #8083ff;
        background: #e8e8ff;
        color: #571bc1;
        font-weight: 600;
      }
      .preview-panel {
        flex: 1;
        padding: 16px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        background: #fff;
        overflow: auto;
      }
      .preview-panel > section,
      .preview-panel > div:not(.snippet-panel):not(.demo-layout) {
        flex: 1;
        width: 100%;
        min-height: 0;
        height: 100%;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
      }
      #example-element {
        min-width: 100%;
        min-height: 100%;
        padding: 10%;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div class="demo-layout">
      <div class="snippet-panel">
        <button class="snippet-btn active" data-index="0">background-color: brown;</button>
        <button class="snippet-btn" data-index="1">background-color: #74992e;</button>
        <button class="snippet-btn" data-index="2">background-color: rgb(255, 255, 128);</button>
        <button class="snippet-btn" data-index="3">background-color: rgba(255, 255, 128, 0.5);</button>
        <button class="snippet-btn" data-index="4">background-color: hsl(50, 33%, 25%);</button>
        <button class="snippet-btn" data-index="5">background-color: hsla(50, 33%, 25%, 0.75);</button>
      </div>
      <div class="preview-panel">
        <section id="default-example">
          <div class="transition-all" id="example-element"></div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const snippets = [
        `#example-element {
  background-color: brown;
}`,
        `#example-element {
  background-color: #74992e;
}`,
        `#example-element {
  background-color: rgb(255, 255, 128);
}`,
        `#example-element {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 128, 0.5);
}`,
        `#example-element {
  background-color: hsl(50, 33%, 25%);
}`,
        `#example-element {
  background-color: hsla(50, 33%, 25%, 0.75);
}`,
      ];

      let styleEl = document.createElement("style");
      document.head.appendChild(styleEl);

      function applySnippet(index) {
        styleEl.textContent = snippets[index];
        document.querySelectorAll(".snippet-btn").forEach((btn, i) => {
          btn.classList.toggle("active", i === index);
        });
      }

      document.querySelectorAll(".snippet-btn").forEach((btn) => {
        btn.addEventListener("click", () => applySnippet(parseInt(btn.dataset.index)));
      });

      applySnippet(0);
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

```
### background-image 背景图片

```css
/* 单张图片 */
.element {
  background-image: url('image.jpg');
  background-image: url('./images/bg.png');
  background-image: url('https://example.com/image.jpg');
}

/* 渐变背景 */
.element {
  /* 线性渐变 */
  background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, red, blue);
  background-image: linear-gradient(to right, #fff, #000);
  background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.8) 100%);
  
  /* 径向渐变 */
  background-image: radial-gradient(circle, red, blue);
  background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #fff, #000);
  
  /* 锥形渐变 */
  background-image: conic-gradient(red, yellow, lime, aqua, blue, magenta, red);
  
  /* 重复渐变 */
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
    45deg,
    #606dbc,
    #606dbc 10px,
    #465298 10px,
    #465298 20px
  );
}

/* 多重背景 */
.element {
  background-image: 
    linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.5), rgba(0,0,0,0.5)),
    url('hero.jpg');
}
```

### background-repeat 背景重复

```css
/* 基础重复 */
.repeat { background-repeat: repeat; }
.repeat-x { background-repeat: repeat-x; }
.repeat-y { background-repeat: repeat-y; }
.no-repeat { background-repeat: no-repeat; }

/* 高级重复 */
.space { background-repeat: space; } /* 等距分布 */
.round { background-repeat: round; } /* 缩放填满 */

/* 双值语法 */
.both { background-repeat: repeat no-repeat; } /* 水平重复，垂直不重复 */
```

### background-position 背景定位

```css
/* 关键字 */
.center { background-position: center; }
.top-left { background-position: left top; }
.bottom-right { background-position: right bottom; }

/* 百分比 */
.percent { background-position: 50% 50%; }

/* 长度值 */
.length { background-position: 20px 30px; }

/* 四值语法 */
.offset { background-position: right 20px bottom 30px; }

/* calc() 计算 */
.calc { background-position: calc(100% - 20px) calc(100% - 20px); }
```

### background-size 背景尺寸

```css
/* 关键字 */
.auto { background-size: auto; }
.cover { background-size: cover; } /* 覆盖容器 */
.contain { background-size: contain; } /* 包含在容器内 */

/* 单值（宽度，高度自动） */
.single { background-size: 50%; }

/* 双值（宽度 高度） */
.both { background-size: 100% 100%; }
.fixed { background-size: 200px 100px; }

/* calc() 计算 */
.calc { background-size: calc(100% - 40px) calc(100% - 40px); }
```

```html
        min-height: 0;
        height: 100%;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
      }
      #example-element {
        background-image: url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");
        background-color: #f0f0f0;
        min-width: 100%;
        min-height: 100%;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div class="demo-layout">
      <div class="snippet-panel">
        <button class="snippet-btn active" data-index="0">background-size: contain;</button>
        <button class="snippet-btn" data-index="1">background-size: contain;</button>
        <button class="snippet-btn" data-index="2">background-size: cover;</button>
        <button class="snippet-btn" data-index="3">background-size: 30%;</button>
        <button class="snippet-btn" data-index="4">background-size: 200px 100px;</button>
      </div>
      <div class="preview-panel">
        <section id="default-example">
          <div class="transition-all" id="example-element"></div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const snippets = [
        `#example-element {
  background-size: contain;
}`,
        `#example-element {
  background-size: contain;
background-repeat: no-repeat;
}`,
        `#example-element {
  background-size: cover;
}`,
        `#example-element {
  background-size: 30%;
}`,
        `#example-element {
  background-size: 200px 100px;
}`,
      ];

      let styleEl = document.createElement("style");
      document.head.appendChild(styleEl);

      function applySnippet(index) {
        styleEl.textContent = snippets[index];
        document.querySelectorAll(".snippet-btn").forEach((btn, i) => {
          btn.classList.toggle("active", i === index);
        });
      }

      document.querySelectorAll(".snippet-btn").forEach((btn) => {
        btn.addEventListener("click", () => applySnippet(parseInt(btn.dataset.index)));
      });

      applySnippet(0);
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

```
### background-attachment 背景附着

```css
/* 基础附着 */
.scroll { background-attachment: scroll; } /* 默认，随页面滚动 */
.fixed { background-attachment: fixed; } /* 固定在视口 */
.local { background-attachment: local; } /* 随元素内容滚动 */

/* 视差效果 */
.parallax {
  height: 100vh;
  background-image: url('bg.jpg');
  background-attachment: fixed;
  background-position: center;
  background-size: cover;
}
```

### background-clip 背景裁剪

```css
/* 裁剪区域 */
.border { background-clip: border-box; } /* 默认，包含边框 */
.padding { background-clip: padding-box; } /* 包含内边距 */
.content { background-clip: content-box; } /* 仅内容区 */
.text { background-clip: text; } /* 文字形状 */

/* 渐变文字 */
.gradient-text {
  background: linear-gradient(45deg, #667eea, #764ba2);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
}
```

### background-origin 背景定位区域

```css
/* 定位原点 */
.border { background-origin: border-box; } /* 从边框开始 */
.padding { background-origin: padding-box; } /* 默认，从内边距开始 */
.content { background-origin: content-box; } /* 从内容区开始 */

/* 配合 background-clip */
.precise {
  background-origin: content-box;
  background-clip: content-box;
  /* 背景只在内容区域显示和定位 */
}
```

### background 简写属性

```css
/* 基础简写 */
.simple { background: #fff; }
.image { background: url('bg.jpg'); }

/* 完整简写 */
.full {
  background: url('bg.jpg') center/cover no-repeat fixed #fff;
}

/* 常见组合 */
.icon { background: url('icon.png') center no-repeat; }
.hero { background: url('hero.jpg') center/cover; }

/* 多重背景简写 */
.multi {
  background: 
    url('overlay.png') center/contain no-repeat,
    url('pattern.png') repeat,
    linear-gradient(#fff, #000),
    #f0f0f0;
}
```

### backdrop-filter 应用

```css
/* 玻璃态效果 */
.glass {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(180%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  border-radius: 16px;
}

/* 模糊背景 */
.blur-bg {
  backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
}

/* 多重滤镜 */
.complex-filter {
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px) brightness(1.1) contrast(1.2);
}

/* 降级方案 */
@supports (backdrop-filter: blur(10px)) {
  .glass {
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  }
}

@supports not (backdrop-filter: blur(10px)) {
  .glass {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); /* 降级 */
  }
}
```

### 渐变完整示例

```css
/* 线性渐变 */
.linear {
  background: linear-gradient(
    45deg, /* 角度 */
    #667eea 0%, /* 起始颜色 */
    #764ba2 100% /* 结束颜色 */
  );
}

/* 多停止点渐变 */
.multi-stop {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    #667eea 0%,
    #764ba2 33%,
    #f093fb 66%,
    #4facfe 100%
  );
}

/* 径向渐变 */
.radial {
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at center, /* 形状和位置 */
    #667eea 0%,
    #764ba2 100%
  );
}

/* 锥形渐变 */
.conic {
  background: conic-gradient(
    from 0deg at 50% 50%,
    #667eea 0deg,
    #764ba2 120deg,
    #f093fb 240deg,
    #667eea 360deg
  );
}

/* 重复渐变 */
.repeating {
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    45deg,
    #606dbc,
    #606dbc 10px,
    #465298 10px,
    #465298 20px
  );
}

/* 条纹背景 */
.stripes {
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    0deg,
    transparent,
    transparent 10px,
    rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 10px,
    rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 20px
  );
}

/* 棋盘格 */
.checkerboard {
  background-image: 
    linear-gradient(45deg, #ccc 25%, transparent 25%),
    linear-gradient(-45deg, #ccc 25%, transparent 25%),
    linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 75%, #ccc 75%),
    linear-gradient(-45deg, transparent 75%, #ccc 75%);
  background-size: 20px 20px;
  background-position: 0 0, 0 10px, 10px -10px, -10px 0px;
}
```

### 多重背景完整示例

```css
/* 图片叠加 */
.overlay {
  background: 
    linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.5), rgba(0,0,0,0.5)), /* 遮罩层 */
    url('hero.jpg') center/cover; /* 背景图 */
}

/* 多图片叠加 */
.layers {
  background-image: 
    url('clouds.png'),
    url('mountains.png'),
    url('sky.jpg');
  background-position: 
    top center,
    bottom center,
    center;
  background-repeat: 
    repeat-x,
    no-repeat,
    no-repeat;
  background-size: 
    auto,
    cover,
    cover;
}

/* 装饰性背景 */
.decorated {
  background: 
    url('corner-tl.png') top left no-repeat,
    url('corner-tr.png') top right no-repeat,
    url('corner-bl.png') bottom left no-repeat,
    url('corner-br.png') bottom right no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(#fff, #f5f5f5);
}

/* 渐变文字 */
.gradient-text {
  background: linear-gradient(45deg, #667eea, #764ba2, #f093fb);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
}
```
